data.body: PR #35 at dd13af9. The loop now runs the checks again after an applied repair and breaks on the budget afterwards, so the reported status always reflects the branch as it stands. A run whose final applied repair turns the checks green reports the passing status with no terminal reason and continues, and the REPAIR_BUDGET_EXCEEDED audit event still records the breach in every case. Plan review signed PASS 0 blocking 0 advisory. Code review PASS 0 blocking 0 advisory. Local inv ci 1530 passed 6 skipped eval-gate PASS, with the 54 existing workflow tests unchanged. GitHub CI pass in 2m29s. All four selectors proven individually, three falsified by reverting the re-run and the fourth by making the re-run unconditional.
